full_judgment: 8. It is further stated that although the heirs of Amu Singha surrendered possession of the suit land to the original plaintiff in 1342 BS, it was wrongly referred to as 1362 B.S. in the plaint of Title Suit No.301 of 1966. Therefore, the plaintiff filed the instant suit for declaration of title and recovery of vacant khas possession upon removing structure, mesne profit and permanent injunction restraining the defendant opposite parties from changing the nature and feature of the suit land.
